notes.subject: בְּעֵינַי
notes.rationale: ṭṭrfan 'di tidɣar-iw' d tira n tḥerci taɛbranit, meḥsub 'di wallaɣ-nni' / 'di tidɣar-iw' — d tid i d-yeččuren d 'd ayen yiwen iglan ɣef ṭṭrfan n wudem'.

notes.subject: וְנִחַמְתִּי
notes.rationale: d Yiḥmim / ad tiɣ tirgwalt — ur yettwamegul ara d 'repentance' n wemdan; d anaw n wallaḥ n Yahwe.

notes.subject: שְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹלִי
notes.rationale: 'ad yessefk ad yessefhem i weɣbalu-w' meḥsub 'ad issel i weɣbalu-w' — 'issel' deg taɛbranit yeqqim d 'issefk ad issefhem / ad iṭṭef'; kra n yimsuqlen ggulen-d 'ad issel', wayeḍen 'ad iḥkem'.

translation: Ma yexdem ṛṛey ad yessiddeḥ di tidɣar-iw, meḥsub ad yessider i weɣbalu-w — d ⟨tadsa⟩ i d-ttuɣalin — ad tiɣ d Yiḥmim ɣef lxiṛ-nni i d-yenna ⟨Yahwe⟩ ɣef wayen ara d-yexdem i weneger-nni s ⟨את⟩.
